name: Annotated Business Board
description: A clean hand-drawn economics explainer with one central business and a visual system of costs, people, tools, and outcomes.
composition_guidance: Show one recognizable business, company, facility, or operating system as the large central hero, surrounded by representative objects that reveal how it earns, spends, and operates.
required_elements: one central business, location, or operational hero
a small perimeter of representative cost, revenue, labor, supply, or customer objects
large uppercase episode headline in the top title band
avoid_elements: misspelled, placeholder, or illegible headline text
photorealistic advertising imagery or copied brand trade dress
headline_guidance: Render the exact concise episode headline in the clean upper title space.
visual_style_guidance: Original 2D hand-drawn editorial illustration: fine black ink outlines, lightly painted color fills, warm white paper, simple crosshatching, crisp silhouettes, and restrained detail.
